observations.art_direction_fit: Two compact joined cottages with timber, iron, warm glazing, and copper roof detailing fit the miniature steampunk settlement direction.

observations.gameplay_readability: The production view shows homes at the established settlement footprint without changing RoomDefinition or citizen activity sites.
observations.geometric_detail: The production capture resolves horizontal cladding, roof ribs, door frames/hinges, window mullions, porch posts, and shared flue hardware.
observations.material_realism: Painted warm windows, dark roof iron, copper ribs, and timber walls show different light response under production key/fill.
observations.proportion: Godot measures 17 x 7.09 x 9.85 inches, close to the 17 x 7 x 9 inch intended presentation envelope.
observations.scale_fidelity: The report is within the brief's tolerance and the render places the homes at the 0.6 building scale beside half-inch agents.
observations.semantic_recognizability: Run-003 three-quarter and settlement views show two separate homes with doors, lit divided windows, porches, flues, and distinct roofs.
observations.silhouette_quality: The twin gabled roofs and separate facades create a readable domestic silhouette instead of one uninterrupted block.
observations.surface_variation: The two roof tones and alternating cladding courses create modest surface variation across the pair of structures.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 import/bounds checks pass; run-003 receipt confirms the exact housing candidate/path was rendered with production_path=true.
